Rashi on Niddah 37b:11:1.english: Rav Ḥisda said: She is impure - For behold, there is relief [from labor pains].

Rashi on Niddah 37b:11:2.hebrew: רבי חנינא אמר טהורה - כיון דשפתה אף מן הדם, איגלאי מילתא דדם הקושי מחמת ולד אתא. אבל כי שפתה מן הצער ורואה דם, איגלאי מילתא דמקמי הכי הוי חזיא נמי בלא קושי:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:11:2.english: Rabbi Ḥanina says: She is pure - Since she had relief also from the blood, it became clear that the blood of travail came because of the child. But when she had relief from the pain and sees blood, it became clear that prior to this, she was seeing [blood] even without travail.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:12:1.english: Before him - One or two days prior to his arrival.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:13:1.english: That he increases soldiers even more - Close to his arrival.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:15:1.hebrew: דפסקו להו חיילות לגמרי - דהשתא ודאי קמאי לא מחמתיה אתו, דאי מחמתיה אתו, כל שכן דמפיש חיילות:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:15:1.english: That the labor pains have ceased entirely - For now, certainly the earlier ones did not come on its [the fetus's] account; for if they had come on its account, all the more so would the labor pains have increased.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:15:2.hebrew: תונבא - אשטורדישו"ן, שאינה מרגשת בצערה מחמת שעמומית החולי:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:15:2.english: Tunba - Estordison [dizziness or stupor], that she does not feel her pain due to the stupor of the illness.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:17:1.hebrew: אי נמי כי קתני - שלשה בקושי וא' בשופי, ובכולן ראתה, למה לי כולי האי:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:17:1.english: Alternatively, when it teaches - Three [days] of labor pains and one of relief, and on all of them she saw [blood] — why do I need all this?

Rashi on Niddah 37b:18:1.english: Or if she experienced labor pains for two [days] and rested for a twenty-four-hour period - On the third [day], from the pain and not from the blood.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:19:1.hebrew: כדקתני - שלשה בקושי, ומקצת שלישי ומקצת רביעי בשופי:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:19:1.english: As it is taught - Three [days] with labor pains, and part of the third and part of the fourth in relief [from pain]:

Rashi on Niddah 37b:19:2.hebrew: הא קמ"ל דאע"ג - דקשתה בקצת שלישי, ולא שפתה לילה ויום כלילי שבת ויומו, אלא לילה ושני חצאי יום, טמאה:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:19:2.english: This teaches us that even though - She experienced labor pains during part of the third [day], and did not rest [for] a night and a day like the night of Shabbat and its day, but rather [for] a night and two half-days, [she is nevertheless] impure.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:19:3.english: And to exclude [the opinion] of Rabbi Ḥanina, son of Rabbi Yehoshua's brother - Who said earlier (Niddah 36b): "Whenever her labor pains occur on her third [day], etc."

Rashi on Niddah 37b:20:1.english: A healthy woman - [Experiences labor pains for] forty [days].

Rashi on Niddah 37b:21:1.hebrew: אין הולד מטהר אלא ימים הראויין להיות בה זבה - דהיינו י"א יום שבין נדה לנדה, אבל ראתה אחריהן, טמאה נדה, כדאמר לעיל: בימי נדה נדה:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:21:1.english: The child renders pure only days that are fit for her to become a zava - That is, the eleven days that are between [one period of] niddah and [the next period of] niddah; but if she saw [blood] after them, she is impure as a niddah, as [the Gemara] said above: "[One who experiences labor pains] during the days of niddah is a niddah."

Rashi on Niddah 37b:21:2.hebrew: אף ימים הראויין לספירת זיבה - כגון התחיל הקושי בימי הזיבה, טהורין כל ימי זיבה ושבעה אחריהם, דהא בתר זבה שייכי. וכי כתב רחמנא בנדתה ולא בזיבתה, דזיבתה טהורה, אהני נמי קאי. אבל אחר שבעה, אם יאריך, טמאה נדה:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:21:2.english: Even days fit for the counting of zivah - For example, [if] the labor began during the days of zivah, all the days of zivah and the seven [days] after them are pure, for they pertain to a zava; and when the Merciful One wrote, "in her niddah and not in her zivah," [meaning] that her zivah is pure, it applies to these [days] as well. But after seven [days], if [the labor] continues, she is impure as a niddah.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:21:3.hebrew: ולטעמיה דרב - כיון דאמר רב, בהנך ימים דשייכי בתר זיבה, טהרינהו רחמנא לענין קושי:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:21:3.english: And according to the reasoning of Rav - Since Rav said [that] in those days that pertain to after zivah, the Merciful One declared them pure with regard to labor pains.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:2:1.hebrew: זב מטמא בין בשלש ראיות ביום אחד, בין בשלש ראיות בג' ימים רצופין, אבל זבה אינה מטמאה אלא בשלשה ימים, כדכתיב בה ימים. בב"ק (דף כד.) מרבינן זב לימים:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:2:1.english: A zav becomes ritually impure whether through three sightings on one day or through three sightings on three consecutive days, but a zava becomes ritually impure only on three days, as it is written concerning her: "days." In Bava Kamma (page 24a), we derive that a zav [also becomes impure through] days.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:5:1.hebrew: נקיים מלידה - שלא תהא לידה ביניהם, דאע"ג דלא חזיא כמאן דחזיא דמי, דהא ימי לידה טמאין בלא דם:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:5:1.english: Clean from birth - That there should not be childbirth among them, for even though she did not see [blood], she is considered like one who saw [blood], as the days of childbirth are impure without blood.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:6:1.hebrew: מה ימי נדתה אין ראויין לזיבה - דאין זבה אלא אחר נדה. ואין ספירת שבעה לזיבה עולה מהן, דהא מכי הויא זבה לא חיילא ימי נדה לעולם עד שתשב שבעה נקיים, וכל דם שרואה אינה אלא סותרת, אבל נדה לא הויא. הילכך, לא משכחת ימי ספירה בימי נדה, ולא ימי נדה בימי ספירה:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:6:1.english: Just as the days of her menstruation are not fit for zivah - For [a woman] only becomes a zava after niddah. And the counting of seven [clean days] for zivah is not reckoned from them, for once she has become a zava, days of niddah never take effect until she observes seven clean days, and any blood that she sees merely negates [her count], but she does not become a niddah. Therefore, you cannot find days of counting during days of niddah, nor days of niddah during days of counting.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:6:2.hebrew: אף ימי לידה - הואיל ודמו לנדה, ואין ראויין לזיבה, כדאמר: ולא דמה מחמת ולד, הכי נמי לענין ספירה מדמינן להו לנדה, ולא תעלה בהן ספירת שבעה, כגון אם ילדה בימי ספירה:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:6:2.english: So too the days of childbirth - Since they were likened to niddah and are not fit for zivah, as it says: "and not her blood on account of a child," so too with regard to counting [the seven clean days], we liken them to niddah, and the counting of seven [clean days] is not reckoned during them, such as if she gave birth during the days of counting.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:6:3.hebrew: הכי גרסינן: אף ימי לידתה שאין ראויין לזיבה, אין ספירת שבעה עולה מהן:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:6:3.english: This is our reading: "So too, the days of her childbirth, which are not fit for zivah, the counting of seven [clean days] is not reckoned from them."

Rashi on Niddah 37b:7:1.hebrew: מסתר נמי סתרה - וכ"ש דלא סלקא. כי היכי דס"ל באונס בזב, שאינו גורם וסותר, ימי לידה נמי, אע"ג דלא גרמי, סתר. וכי קאמינא אנא לרבנן, דאמרי דבר שאינו גורם אינו סותר, אינה סותרת ועולה:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:7:1.english: It also negates - And all the more so that it does not count [toward the seven clean days]. Just as he [Rabbi Eliezer] holds regarding [an emission due to] circumstances beyond one's control in a zav, which does not cause [the status of a zav] and [yet] negates [the clean days], so too the days of childbirth, even though they do not cause [the status of zivah], negate [the clean days]. And when I [Rava] spoke, [it was] according to the Rabbis, who say [that] a matter that does not cause [zivah] does not negate [the clean days; therefore, childbirth] does not negate, and it counts [toward the seven clean days].

Rashi on Niddah 37b:8:1.english: And does one derive the possible - Such as childbirth, for it is possible for her to give birth during the days of [her] counting.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:8:2.hebrew: משאי אפשר - מימי נדה, דלא אפשר להיות נדה בימי ספירה:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:8:2.english: From that which is impossible - From the days of nidda, for it is impossible to be a nidda during the days of counting.

Rashi on Niddah 37b:9:1.hebrew: ר' אליעזר היא - במסכת מנחות, בפ' התודה, דיליף פסח דורות מפסח מצרים שלא יביא אלא מן החולין. אמר לו ר"ע: וכי דנין אפשר משאי אפשר? במצרים אכתי לא הוה מעשר, אבל לדורות, דאיכא מעות מעשר שני, נייתי מנייהו! אמר לו: אף ע"פ שאי אפשר, ראיה גדולה היא ונלמד הימנה:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:9:1.english: It is Rabbi Eliezer - In tractate Menachot, in the chapter [entitled] "HaToda," where he derives [the law of] the Paschal offering of [future] generations from the Paschal offering of Egypt, that one may bring it only from non-sacred funds. Rabbi Akiva said to him: "And does one derive the possible from the impossible? In Egypt there was not yet [the law of] tithe, but for [future] generations, where there is second-tithe money, let them bring [it] from it!" He said to him: "Even though it is impossible, it is a great proof, and we shall learn from it."

Rashi on Niddah 37b:9:2.hebrew: הקישן הכתוב - ואפי' לר"ע, הני מילי דאין דנין כגון גזרה שוה, אבל הקישא אין משיבין על ההיקש:
Rashi on Niddah 37b:9:2.english: The verse juxtaposed them - And even according to Rabbi Akiva, this principle that one does not derive [the possible from the impossible applies to a derivation] such as a gezeira shava; however, regarding a juxtaposition, one does not refute a juxtaposition.

Tosafot on Niddah 37b:20:1.hebrew: ארבעים מיבעיא - בסוכה לא פריך כי האי גוונא ארבי יהודה, דמכשיר עד ארבעים וחמשים אמה. התם — משום דקים ליה דלאו דוקא, אלא ארבעים וחמשים כדאמרי אינשי, ואפילו טובא; אבל הכא הוי דוקא חמשים, כדקתני בסמוך: וחמשים שהולד מטהר. ובפרק מפנין (שבת דף קכו:) דפריך: השתא ה' קופות, ד' מיבעיא? — המקשה סבר דדוקא נקט, ומשני דלאו דוקא נקט, אלא ד' וה' כדאמרי אינשי; ועוד משני דהוה דוקא: ד' מאוצר קטן וה' מאוצר גדול. ובפרק אע"פ (כתובות דף ס.), תינוק יונק אפי' ד' וה' שנים — נמי לא דייק; התם משום דלאו דוקא ה', אלא לפי צרכו, כדקאמר התם: ואפילו חבילתו על כתפו. ובפרק הזרוע (חולין דף קלב:) דאמר: כהן טבח ב' וג' שבתות פטור מן המתנות, מכאן ואילך חייב במתנות — התם נקט ב' לרבי, דאמר בתרי זימני הוה חזקה, ולרשב"ג ג':
Tosafot on Niddah 37b:20:1.english: Is [mentioning] forty necessary? - In [tractate] Sukkah (2a), [the Gemara] does not object in this manner against Rabbi Yehuda, who validates [a sukkah] up to forty or fifty cubits. There, [it does not object] because it is clear to it that [the formulation] is not exact, but rather "forty or fifty" is as people colloquially say, and even much [higher is valid]; but here, fifty is exact, as it teaches nearby: "and the fifty [days] that the child purifies." And in the chapter [entitled] "Mefanin" (Shabbat 126b), where [the Gemara] asks: "Now [that one may clear] five baskets, is [mentioning] four necessary?" — the questioner thought that [the Tanna] stated [them] precisely, and [the Gemara] answers that he did not state [them] precisely, but rather "four and five" as people colloquially say; and furthermore it answers that it is indeed exact: four from a small storeroom and five from a large storeroom. And in the chapter [entitled] "Af Al Pi" (Ketubot 60a), [regarding the statement,] "A child nurses even four or five years," [the Gemara] also did not infer [a question]; there, because "five" is not exact, but rather according to his need, as it says there: "even if his bundle is on his shoulder." And in the chapter [entitled] "HaZeroa" (Chullin 132b), where it states: "A priest who is a butcher is exempt from the [priestly] gifts for two or three weeks; from that point forward he is obligated in the gifts" — there, it stated "two" according to Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi], who says that a presumption is established after two times, and according to Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, "three".

Tosafot on Niddah 37b:21:1.hebrew: ורב אדא בר אהבה אמר אף ימים הראויים לספירת סתירת זיבתה - וא"ת: מה הוסיף על דברי רב? הא לרב נמי הראויין לספירה היינו ז' ימים אחר י"א יום, ואז מתחילות י"א אחרים שהם ימי זיבה, וא"כ לדידיה נמי לעולם קושי מטהר! וי"ל, דאינה נדה עד שיעברו שבעה ימי הספירה אחר י"א. ואם ראתה אז, אף בקושי, טמאה לרב; ולרב אדא טהורה, דראויין לספירת סתירת זיבתה. ור"ח פי', דלוי אינו מטהר אלא תשעה ימים הראוין ליעשות בהן זבה; אבל י' וי"א, דאינם ראויין ליעשות בהן זבה, דאפילו ראתה אפי' גם בי"ב אינה אלא נדה. ורב מוסיף ימים הראויין לספירה, כגון עשירי וי"א וחמשה ימים אחרי כן; אבל שני ימים משבעה ימים אחרונים, אם ראתה בהן, טמאה לרב. ורב אדא מוסיף אף אותם שני ימים, ונמצא כולן טהורין:
Tosafot on Niddah 37b:21:1.english: And Rav Adda bar Ahava said: Even days that are fit for counting [following] the negation of her zivah - And if you say: What did [Rav Adda] add to the words of Rav? For according to Rav as well, [the days] that are fit for counting are the seven days after the eleven days [of zivah], and then another eleven [days] begin, which are days of zivah; and if so, according to him as well, difficulty [of labor] would always purify! And one can say: That she does not become a niddah until the seven days of counting pass after the eleven [days of zivah]. And if she saw [blood] then, even due to difficulty [of labor], she is impure according to Rav; but according to Rav Adda, she is pure, for they are fit for counting [following] the negation of her zivah. And Rabbeinu Chananel explained: That Levi purifies only nine days that are fit to become a zava in them; but the tenth and eleventh [days] are not fit to become a zava in them, for even if she saw [blood on them], and even also on the twelfth, she is merely a niddah. And Rav adds days that are fit for counting, such as the tenth and eleventh [days], and five days after them; but [as for] the two [remaining] days of the final seven days, if she saw [blood] on them, she is impure according to Rav. And Rav Adda adds even those two days, and it turns out that all of them are pure.

Tosafot on Niddah 37b:6:1.hebrew: מה ימי נדותה דאין ראוין לזיבה - וא"ת, דבשילהי בא סימן (לקמן נדה דף נד.) אמר ימי נדותה שאינה רואה בהן עולין לספירת זיבתה? וי"ל, דהתם מיירי בזבה קטנה שרואה יום י"א, דיום י"ב הויא ביה תחלת נדה, ועולה לה:
Tosafot on Niddah 37b:6:1.english: Just as the days of her menstruation are not fit for zivah - And if you say that at the end of [the chapter] "Ba Siman" (below, Niddah 54a), [the Gemara] says [that] the days of her menstruation on which she does not see [blood] count toward the counting of her zivah — one can say that there, it is dealing with a minor zavah (zavah ketanah) who sees [blood on] the eleventh day, as the twelfth day is the beginning of [her days of] menstruation, and it counts for her.

Tosafot on Niddah 37b:9:1.hebrew: על כרחך הקישן הכתוב - ואין משיבין על ההיקש. וא"ת, והא בפ' התודה (מנחות דף פב.) פריך ר"ע לר' אליעזר: וכי דנין אפשר משאי אפשר, אע"ג דטעמא דרבי אליעזר דדריש היקשא מועבדת שיהו כל העבודות שוות, ור"ע נמי אית ליה היקשא דועבדת בפרק מי שהיה טמא (פסחים דף צו.)? וי"ל, דהתם לא מצי למימר על כרחך הקישן הכתוב, דאיצטריך היקשא להנהו דרשות דפסחים (דף צו.):
Tosafot on Niddah 37b:9:1.english: Perforce the verse juxtaposed them - And one does not refute a juxtaposition (hekesh). And if you say: But in the chapter [entitled] "HaTodah" (Menachot 82a), Rabbi Akiva objected to Rabbi Eliezer, "Does one derive the possible from the impossible?", even though Rabbi Eliezer's reason is that he expounds a juxtaposition from "and you shall perform" (ve-avadeta) that all the services should be equal, and Rabbi Akiva also accepts the juxtaposition of "ve-avadeta" in the chapter [entitled] "Mi SheHayah Tamei" (Pesachim 96a)? And it can be answered that there, one cannot say "perforce the verse juxtaposed them," for the juxtaposition was needed for those expositions in Pesachim (96a).
